newsitem.title: FRANCE: BIENNAL LYON AIR CARGO CONFERENCE SET FOR DEC 4.
newsitem.headline: BIENNAL LYON AIR CARGO CONFERENCE SET FOR DEC 4.

text.p: Lyon-Satolas airport is to hold its biennal air cargo conference, Les Assises du Fret Aerien on December 4 1997, an official for Info Fret, a steering group set up by the air cargo community at the airport, said.
Info Fret groups regional representatives of France's air freight forwarding agents (SNAGFA), shippers, airlines, customs and the Lyon airport authority's freight marketing department.
"The conference programme is currently being finalised," an airport authority official said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
